The pilot included 42 volunteers and reported 12% lower water use over six weeks. It did not use a randomized control group.

Summary: The pilot program, with 42 participants, resulted in a 12% reduction in water use over a six-week period without a randomized control group for comparison. Limitations: The absence of a control group makes it difficult to attribute the reduction in water use soleledly to the pilot program. Reference ID: s313cf659-p1-ae815b19

The pilot study reported a 12% reduction in water use among 42 volunteers over a six-week period but did not use a randomized control group, which limits the strength of the findings in terms of causal inference. [s313cf659-p1-ae815b19]
